text:
Ashley: Heads up — holdlist backlog causing shortage in us-west-2. Found ~24 idle reservations >48h flagged as holds. Finance noticed charges for them and wants answers. Any context on who created these holds? :eyes:

Devon: We allow internal holds for trial/proof-of-concept teams, default TTL 24h. 24 idle >48h means TTL not enforced. I'll look.

Sasha: Can you paste the query that finds them?

Ashley: db query:
```sql
SELECT id, owner, state, created_at, last_active_at FROM gpu_reservations WHERE state='hold' AND last_active_at < now() - interval '48 hours';
```
Returned 24 rows. Sample ids: r-8421, r-9102, r-1018.

infra-bot: reservation-manager detected stale-hold r-8421,r-9102,r-1018 at 2026-03-18T14:05:23Z

Devon: Looks like a regression after the canceler job failed last night. Logs:
```bash
2026-03-17T23:12:01Z ERROR canceler.Service: failed to delete reservation r-8421: timeout
```
I'll redeploy canceler.

finance-bot: FYI holds are billed under 'compute-hold' SKU at 30% of reserved rate. That explains the unexpected line items. If we release and credit may require support ticket.

Arjun: Suggest change: reduce default TTL to 6h for 'trial' holds and add 'soft-hold' (preemptible) vs 'hard-hold' (non-preemptible). Soft-hold charges 10% and can be auto-evicted.

Becca: Agree. Also need a queue backlog metric: holds_by_age histogram + alerts when >12 old. Right now we only alert on capacity <10%.

Priya: For immediate relief — can someone run:
```bash
ri reservation release --ids r-8421 r-9102 r-1018 --force
```

Devon: Running now...
```
$ ri reservation release --ids r-8421 r-9102 r-1018 --force
Released: r-8421
Released: r-9102
Released: r-1018
```
Freed 3 GPUs.

Ashley: Nice. Can we mass release 20 more? What's the safest filter?

Devon: I'll run release for holds with last_active_at < now() - 72h and owner like '%trial%':
```sql
DELETE FROM gpu_reservations WHERE state='hold' AND last_active_at < now() - interval '72 hours' AND owner LIKE '%trial%';
```
But want sign-off from product/legal for users on active trials.

Arjun: For product teams, we can whitelist owners with 'project:retain' tag. Otherwise automate.

Becca: Action items: 1) Restart canceler job (Devon) 2) Add TTL change PR (Arjun) 3) Billing support case for credits (Ashley/Finance) 4) Add alert for holds >12h (Becca) 5) Run mass release with safelist by EOD (Devon).

Ashley: I'll file the billing ticket and loop in @finance. Assigning to Devon/Arjun/Becca. Thanks :thumbsup:

Devon: On it. I'll post runbook when done.
